Story.title: Story
Story.description: A user's private writing session / story containing ordered manuscript sections, with 30-day soft-delete Trash support.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the story owner.

defaultStyle.description: Default writing style selected for new recordings in this story.

defaultRefinedEnding.description: Default Burmese voice ending when Refined Flow is active.

defaultModel.description: Default Gemini model selected for this story.

sectionCount.description: Current number of active sections belonging to this story (0..5000).

glossary.description: Optional per-story writer glossary of character names, places, and preferred spellings injected into Gemini prompts.

isDeleted.description: Whether the story has been soft-deleted into the 30-day Trash Bin.

deletedAt.description: Server timestamp when the story was moved to Trash, or null when active.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the story was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the story was last updated.

Section.title: Section
Section.description: A single transcribed or uploaded voice section inside a story, with non-destructive version history, token/cost usage metadata, Firebase Storage audio metadata, and 30-day soft-delete support.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the section owner.

order.description: Monotonic numeric ordering key preserving chronological order across devices.

content.description: Active version prose text synchronized with versions[activeVersionIndex].text.

style.description: Writing style of the currently active version.

refinedEnding.description: Burmese voice ending of the currently active version.

model.description: Gemini model used for the currently active version.

mode.description: Processing mode used for this section.

versions.description: Bounded non-destructive version history array (1..50 items), each optionally containing token/cost usage metadata.

activeVersionIndex.description: Zero-based index of the currently active version inside versions.

audioUrl.description: Firebase Storage download URL for the original audio clip (or empty string).

storagePath.description: Firebase Storage object path users/{uid}/audio/{storyId}/{sectionId}.{ext} (or empty string).

audioId.description: Optional local fallback audio clip ID.

audioMeta.description: Metadata describing the recorded or uploaded audio file.

isDeleted.description: Whether this section has been soft-deleted into the 30-day Trash Bin.

deletedAt.description: Server timestamp when moved to Trash, or null when active.

parentStoryId.description: Original story ID preserved for independent Trash viewing and restoration.

parentStoryTitle.description: Original story title snapshot at the time the section was moved to Trash.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the section was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the section was last modified.

TrashedSection.title: TrashedSection
TrashedSection.description: Independent Trash Bin index entry for a soft-deleted individual section so it can be previewed, played, copied, auto-purged after 30 days, or restored even if its parent story was permanently deleted.

/users/{userId}/stories/{storyId}.description: Private stories (active and soft-deleted) owned by the authenticated whitelisted user.

/users/{userId}/stories/{storyId}/sectio.description: Ordered manuscript sections, version histories, and token usage belonging to a story.

/users/{userId}/trashedSections/{section.description: Soft-deleted individual sections stored for 30-day Trash Bin viewing, playback, restoration, and automatic cleanup.
